description: This file contains implementation of functions and classes for configuring and generating radio network components related to 5G NR, including serving cell configuration, carrier configuration, search spaces, CORESETs, PDSCH, PUCCH, SSB, SRS, and CSI configurations. It is part of a scheduler configuration module for 5G NR base station or UE.

classes.name: cell_config_builder_params_extended
classes.description: Extended configuration parameters for cell setup, including methods to derive default configurations and validate TDD patterns.

methods.name: make_default_dl_carrier_configuration
methods.description: Creates default downlink carrier configuration based on extended parameters.

methods.name: make_default_ul_carrier_configuration
methods.description: Creates default uplink carrier configuration based on extended parameters.

methods.name: make_default_coreset_config
methods.description: Generates default CORESET configuration for a given CORESET ID.

methods.name: make_default_coreset0_config
methods.description: Generates default CORESET#0 configuration based on parameters.

methods.name: make_default_search_space_zero_config
methods.description: Creates default search space configuration for the zero index.

methods.name: make_default_common_search_space_config
methods.description: Creates default common search space configuration.

methods.name: make_default_ue_search_space_config
methods.description: Creates default UE-specific search space configuration.

methods.name: make_default_init_bwp
methods.description: Creates default initial bandwidth part configuration.

methods.name: make_ue_dedicated_pdcch_config
methods.description: Creates dedicated PDCCH configuration for UE.

methods.name: create_default_initial_ue_serving_cell_config
methods.description: Creates default initial serving cell configuration for UE.

methods.name: create_default_initial_ue_cell_config
methods.description: Creates default initial UE cell configuration.

methods.name: compute_max_nof_candidates
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of candidates for a given aggregation level and CORESET configuration.
